name: Total Pirate War
detailed_description:
TOTAL PIRATE WAR

Thank you for your interest in TotalPirateWar. We would like to inform you that the demo currently available on Steam is a pre-release version designed to allow players to explore the game's mechanics and gameplay.

It is important to note that this demo does not represent the final version of the game. The development team is working hard to improve aspects such as graphics, content, optimization, and the overall experience based on the feedback received.

Your opinion is important to us and we invite you to share your feedback to help us create an unforgettable experience in the world of TotalPirateWar.

We appreciate your support and enthusiasm as we continue to develop this project.

Welcome Pirates! to the exciting waters of TOTAL PIRATE WAR.

Sail in this exciting sea of adventure, where you will compete in Battle Royale mode on the high seas. The main objective is to accumulate gold and precious items that will allow you to equip, improve, and beautify your pirate ship, until you become the king of the seas.

Total Pirate War offers a unique experience where strategy, exploration and naval skills are key to becoming the most feared pirate on the seas.

The game is designed in Unreal Engine 5 for PC.

Open world

Explore islands, ports, and uncharted waters in search of treasures and missions. You can trade, form alliances or attack other players at any time.

Pirate Battle

A group of players face off in a vast ocean, competing for treasure and resources. The last boat wins.

Upgrade your Ship

Use the gold obtained in your missions to upgrade your pirate ship. Increase speed, carrying capacity, and strengthen defenses to take on bigger threats.

Missions

Complete missions at sea, ranging from treasure hunting to hostage rescue. Each mission offers unique rewards and challenges that showcase your skills and bravery.

Constant Threats

Enemy ships, including the fearsome Spanish fleet, patrol the waters to protect the gold that the galleons transport from America to Spain. Get ready to face intense naval battles and strategic plundering.

Online Multiplayer

Connect with other players in real time, form strategic alliances or challenge your rivals in intense naval battles.

Interaction with NPC

From merchants to cunning smugglers, each NPC character is an opportunity to trade, compete, or ally. Make impactful decisions that will affect your reputation and unlock new possibilities in your quest for pirate greatness. Each encounter with an NPC is a crucial piece of your story, so choose wisely and forge your own destiny among the seas!.
